ARKhives 8.19.13 — Video playback and workspace recovery

- Fix long MP4 recordings remaining at 00:00 while the browser scans thousands of media-data boxes. Compatible recordings receive a read-only streaming view; original recordings, sample positions and timestamps remain intact.
- Avoid rereading notebook bodies and recalculating file fingerprints for every video range request. Source access remains account-authorized, and changed, removed or relinked files invalidate the cached metadata.
- Replace the loading strip with the original animated ARKhives login symbol, centered inside the video pane. Brief seeks avoid flashing a loader, and extended buffering exposes recovery actions.
- Retry playback restores position, speed and sound, then starts playback. Missing files, changed recordings and expired access receive clearer messages.
- Reopening the active lesson retains its player and notebook. Leaving a lesson releases its media stream. Scrubbing avoids excessive seek requests and repeated control redraws.
- Refine transitions and control feedback while respecting reduced motion. Desktop lesson presentation remains independent of mobile presentation; the shared learning engine is unchanged.

The signed update preserves local question banks, progress, notebooks and recordings. Lessons are not uploaded by this patch.
